findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: barcode_svg · Private data: receipt_pdf, crypto_pay_uri · Public sink: invoice_pdf, receipt_pdf, crypto_pay_uri, phone_validate, phone_extract, barcode_svg · Destructive: invoice_pdf, receipt_pdf, barcode_svg.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: barcode_svg · Private data: receipt_pdf, crypto_pay_uri · Public sink: invoice_pdf, receipt_pdf, crypto_pay_uri, phone_validate, phone_extract, barcode_svg · Destructive: invoice_pdf, receipt_pdf, barcode_svg

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
